name: percolator
description: Research Solana launches and perp markets for $0.01420 USDC, no account. PumpAI launch tools, Bubblemaps documentation, read-only Percolator and Imperial market guidance, and the owner skill bundle. Default mode is read-only. Production writes stay off.

rpc_api_key.title: RPC API key
rpc_api_key.description: Helius or Triton RPC key for devnet or mainnet compressed-account examples. Not used on localnet. Enter it here. Do not read it from the environment.

solana_keypair.title: Solana keypair path
solana_keypair.description: Path to a Solana keypair file you choose for devnet or mainnet examples. The plugin does not look in your home directory.

uniswap_api_key.title: Uniswap API key
uniswap_api_key.description: Uniswap Trading API key for 402 funding flows. Enter it here. Do not read UNISWAP_API_KEY from the environment.

source_private_key.title: Source wallet private key
source_private_key.description: Optional hex key for 402 signing when cast wallet import is not used. Enter it here for this session. Do not read PRIVATE_KEY from the environment or from disk.
